prior_correction.formula: p = softmax(model logits) (no temperature scaling); score = log(p + epsilon) + alpha * log_prior; corrected probabilities = softmax(score); prediction = argmax(score)
prior_correction.source: Validated on Kaggle (boost_settings.json; paper table1_method_comparison.csv, row 'prior correction only (alpha=0.3, no TTA)')

confidence_levels.description: High > 80%, Medium 50-80%, Low < 50% (of the corrected top-class probability)
